_about: How flh_realism drives a channel's instrument. A library entry matches the channel's plugin / VST / preset text (regex, first hit wins). controllers: which MIDI CCs the library reads as dynamics (crossfade between soft and loud samples) and expression (volume); host_params: the plugin's own automatable parameters by name (index when known: verified=true only after someone checked it in FL with fl_plugin_params). legato: the library plays connected notes as legato transitions when notes overlap (articulation names containing legato_word). articulations: our names -> words to look for in the library's articulation names. keyswitches: {our articulation: MIDI note} for libraries that switch articulation by note (none shipped: they differ per patch; add yours). Users override with <fl-headless state folder>/realism/libraries.json.

wrapper._about: FL's VST wrapper exposes 4096 parameter slots, then MIDI CC 0..127 as parameters 4096..4223 (then aftertouch per MIDI channel). An automation clip on parameter 4096 + n sends CC n to the plugin. PC-VERIFY (checklists/realism.md)

libraries.name: Kontakt (most orchestral libraries: CC1 dynamics, CC11 expression)
Other sampled orchestral VSTs (CC1 dynamics / CC11 expression convention)

generic_vst._about: any other VST/VST3 in an orchestral family (strings, choir, brass, winds): the CC1/CC11 convention is assumed (honestly reported as an assumption); pads/synths get the velocity + volume fallback because a synth's mod wheel is usually vibrato or a filter
